{{Top|leg}}
'''Passenger blisters''' were a part of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]]. They were the same size and shape as [[weapons blister]]s. Many of the cruisers belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had their passenger blisters replaced with weapons blisters during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
